limitations: Client recipe records may include conditional or unavailable content.
Craft success probabilities not supplied by the endpoint remain null.
List probabilities use basis points; detail probabilities use percent.
Null fees are unknown, not silently converted to zero.
Market availability and tradability require separate server-specific market observations.

rates.curveIndex: Clamp proficiency minus required mastery to the curve array bounds; rate[0] base success, rate[1] combo success.
